title: DeRot lets you choose how firm the pause is:

copy.threads_text:
DeRot lets you choose how firm the pause is:

Stay the course: the reset finishes before the app opens.
Flexible: skip after 10 seconds if you want to.
Gentle reminder: a soft nudge, nothing required.

Some days you want a firm hand. Some days you just want a tap on the shoulder.

images.alt: Three levels of firm Pick the one that fits how you want to feel.
